faq.answer: You can register online through the NVSP portal (nvsp.in) or by filling Form 6 at your local Electoral Registration Office. You must be an Indian citizen and 18 years or older.
Required documents include a passport-sized photograph, age proof (Birth Certificate/Aadhaar), and address proof (Ration Card/Passport/Electricity bill).
1. Check name in list. 2. Mark finger with ink. 3. Cast vote on EVM. 4. Verify on VVPAT.
EVMs are electronic machines to record votes. VVPAT prints a slip to verify your vote. Press the blue button next to your candidate's symbol.
